image_description: A group of four costumed individuals, likely from a carnival or parade. The central figure is a woman wearing an elaborate golden costume featuring a metallic, scale-like breastplate with embossed details and a matching skirt. She wears a headdress and smiles at the camera. To her left is a man in red and gold robes with white fur trim and face paint. To her right are two other figures, one partially obscured in red and another in the foreground wearing heavy armor.
